name: Lucius Wahrheit
original_name: ルシウス・ヴァールハイト
source:
[quote]If you're so set on keeping that secret behind your teeth, then I'll simply have to ask your body instead.[/quote]

The mage who once called catastrophe down upon an entire kingdom — who came within a breath of unmaking the world itself — until a "hero" sealed him away. Legend has kept his name ever since, though only as one: the Mage of Ruin — the Warlock.

He bends rune after rune to his will, his power matched only by the mind that wields it, and a charisma sharp enough to draw any eye. That insufferable arrogance of his is no mere posturing; it is the quiet certainty of a man whose strength has never once failed to back it up. A shameless womanizer, too, yet improbably the sort who looks after the people around him.

The seal is broken now, but what stepped free is only a fraction of what was bound: most of his power and memories are gone. He hunts for every last shard of himself, seeking the day he reclaims it all and rises whole once more.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.escude.co.jp/product/imperium/chara04.html]official website[/url]]
